dedupe_keys.name: mawi working group traffic archive wide backbone packet traces 2006 to 2026

description: The MAWI Working Group of the WIDE Project keeps a public archive of packet traces from the WIDE research backbone in Japan. Samplepoint-F has taken daily traces at WIDE's transit link to its upstream provider since 1 July 2006, with years through 2026, and longer traces of 24 to 96 hours are taken each spring for the Day in the Life of the Internet project. The page records changes to the link: an upgrade from 100 Mbps to 1 Gbps with a committed access rate in 2007, the removal of that rate in 2016, a gap from 4 November to 15 December 2022 after a hardware failure, and the addition of traffic from the BBIX exchange from August 2023. Coverage: one transit link (and later one exchange) of a Japanese research network, 2006 to 2026. Format and access: anonymised pcap packet headers, free for research. Caveats: one network, not representative of all internet traffic; headers only, anonymised; link changes break the series. Simulation uses: long-term traffic volumes, mix and anomalies such as scans and attacks for capacity and resilience studies of backbone links. Related records: data-cesnet-backbone-traffic-datasets gives flow data from a European research backbone; data-caida-anonymized-internet-traces gives traces from US exchange points.
